# BOOM! Healthcare Communications

> BOOM! is an independent, award-winning healthcare communications agency of 65 specialists, with offices in London, Bournemouth and Copenhagen. It brings together the right people around each brief to help pharma, biotech and medtech teams build brands, educate audiences and drive advocacy, with experience across 300+ brands, 50+ launches and 70+ therapy areas.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.boom-cc.com/)
- [Work](https://www.boom-cc.com/work): selected case studies
- [Services](https://www.boom-cc.com/services): insights, strategy and communications, Veeva content, how we work and procurement information
- [Therapy areas](https://www.boom-cc.com/therapy-areas): specialist areas, audiences and the full list of 70+ therapy areas
- [About](https://www.boom-cc.com/about): story, values and the leadership team
- [Careers](https://www.boom-cc.com/careers): culture, perks and how to get in touch
- [Contact](https://www.boom-cc.com/contact): enquiries, credentials, procurement and careers
